en.setting: Thornfield Crossing is a two-platform junction station shrouded in November fog. The clock above the gate has stopped, the lamps burn low, and the thirty-two minutes between the last arrival and the first departure belong to no one.
en.crime: Aldous Verne was found dead on platform two. His watch stopped at 11:16 and a cipher sheet lay pinned beneath his blotter.

suspects.name: Renard Voss
suspects.intro: A man with a damp coat and tight handwriting in the station ledger, carrying a satchel marked with his initials.

suspects.name: The Estranged Daughter
suspects.intro: A young woman waiting on platform two with a small bouquet wrapped in railway paper.

suspects.name: The Stationmaster
suspects.intro: On duty for the 11pm watch, his brass watch chain tucked away and his name in the log.

suspects.name: The Night Porter
suspects.intro: Carries a brass key ring with three keys missing and boots clean of coal dust.

suspects.name: The Platform Guard
suspects.intro: His lantern hook is empty and his gloves are dry despite the fog.

suspects.name: The Railway Clerk
suspects.intro: Fresh ink on two fingers and cuffs neatly folded back at the station office.

suspects.name: The Travelling Broker
suspects.intro: A man in a grey coat with an unused first-class ticket, waiting in the lounge.

es.setting: Thornfield Crossing es una estacion de empalme de dos andenes envuelta en niebla de noviembre. El reloj sobre la puerta se ha detenido, las lamparas arden con poca luz, y los treinta y dos minutos entre la ultima llegada y la primera salida no pertenecen a nadie.
es.crime: Aldous Verne fue encontrado muerto en el anden dos. Su reloj se detuvo a las 11:16 y una hoja cifrada yacia bajo su secante.

suspects.name: Renard Voss
suspects.intro: Un hombre con abrigo humedo y escritura apretada en el registro de la estacion, con un maletin marcado con sus iniciales.

suspects.name: La Hija Distanciada
suspects.intro: Una joven esperando en el anden dos con un pequeno ramo envuelto en papel de ferrocarril.

suspects.name: El Jefe de Estacion
suspects.intro: De guardia en el turno de las 11pm, su cadena de reloj de laton guardada y su nombre en el registro.

suspects.name: El Portero Nocturno
suspects.intro: Lleva un llavero de laton con tres llaves faltantes y botas limpias de polvo de carbon.

suspects.name: El Guardia de Anden
suspects.intro: Su gancho de linterna esta vacio y sus guantes secos a pesar de la niebla.

suspects.name: El Empleado Ferroviario
suspects.intro: Tinta fresca en dos dedos y punos cuidadosamente doblados en la oficina de la estacion.

suspects.name: El Corredor Viajero
suspects.intro: Un hombre con abrigo gris y un billete de primera clase sin usar, esperando en el salon.

fr.setting: Thornfield Crossing est une gare de jonction a deux quais enveloppee dans le brouillard de novembre. L'horloge au-dessus du portail s'est arretee, les lampes brulent bas, et les trente-deux minutes entre la derniere arrivee et le premier depart n'appartiennent a personne.
fr.crime: Aldous Verne a ete retrouve mort sur le quai deux. Sa montre s'est arretee a 11h16 et une feuille chiffree etait epinglee sous son buvard.

suspects.name: Renard Voss
suspects.intro: Un homme au manteau humide et a l'ecriture serree dans le registre de la gare, portant une sacoche marquee de ses initiales.

suspects.name: La Fille Eloignee
suspects.intro: Une jeune femme attendant sur le quai deux avec un petit bouquet enveloppe dans du papier de chemin de fer.

suspects.name: Le Chef de Gare
suspects.intro: De service pour le quart de 23h, sa chaine de montre en laiton rangee et son nom dans le registre.

suspects.name: Le Porteur de Nuit
suspects.intro: Porte un trousseau de cles en laiton avec trois cles manquantes et des bottes propres de poussiere de charbon.

suspects.name: Le Garde de Quai
suspects.intro: Son crochet de lanterne est vide et ses gants sont secs malgre le brouillard.

suspects.name: L'Employe de Chemin de Fer
suspects.intro: De l'encre fraiche sur deux doigts et des manchettes soigneusement repliees au bureau de la gare.

suspects.name: Le Courtier Voyageur
suspects.intro: Un homme en manteau gris avec un billet de premiere classe inutilise, attendant dans le salon.

physical_evidence.en: The cipher sheet pinned beneath Verne's blotter carried ink that matched the satchel's interior lining. The stopped watch at 11:16 placed the killing inside the thirty-two-minute window, and the damp coat left a water trail from platform two to the station gate.
physical_evidence.es: La hoja cifrada bajo el secante de Verne llevaba tinta que coincidia con el forro interior del maletin. El reloj detenido a las 11:16 situaba el crimen dentro de la ventana de treinta y dos minutos, y el abrigo humedo dejo un rastro de agua desde el anden dos hasta la puerta de la estacion.
physical_evidence.fr: La feuille chiffree sous le buvard de Verne portait une encre correspondant a la doublure de la sacoche. La montre arretee a 11h16 placait le meurtre dans la fenetre de trente-deux minutes, et le manteau humide laissait une trainee d'eau du quai deux au portail de la gare.

witness_testimony.en: The stationmaster saw Voss sign the ledger with tight handwriting and leave through the fog toward platform two. The night porter confirmed three keys missing from his ring, and the railway clerk's fresh ink placed him at the office window during the crucial half hour.
witness_testimony.es: El jefe de estacion vio a Voss firmar el registro con escritura apretada y salir por la niebla hacia el anden dos. El portero nocturno confirmo tres llaves faltantes de su llavero, y la tinta fresca del empleado ferroviario lo situaba en la ventana de la oficina durante la media hora crucial.
witness_testimony.fr: Le chef de gare a vu Voss signer le registre d'une ecriture serree et partir dans le brouillard vers le quai deux. Le porteur de nuit a confirme trois cles manquantes sur son trousseau, et l'encre fraiche de l'employe placait celui-ci a la fenetre du bureau pendant la demi-heure cruciale.

financial_trail.en: The doctored ledger showed entries in two hands, and the telegram from the bank confirmed Verne carried proof of the fraud in a sealed envelope. Voss's monogrammed satchel held the duplicate accounts that would have ended his brokerage.
financial_trail.es: El libro de cuentas manipulado mostraba entradas de dos manos, y el telegrama del banco confirmo que Verne llevaba pruebas del fraude en un sobre sellado. El maletin con monograma de Voss contenia las cuentas duplicadas que habrian terminado con su correduria.
financial_trail.fr: Le registre falsifie montrait des ecritures de deux mains, et le telegramme de la banque confirmait que Verne portait la preuve de la fraude dans une enveloppe scellee. La sacoche monogrammee de Voss contenait les doubles comptes qui auraient mis fin a son courtage.

emotional_tells.en: Voss kept his hands in his coat pockets and his voice level, but the satchel swap betrayed haste. The estranged daughter's bouquet was still wrapped in railway paper when she was told. The platform guard's dry gloves said he had not been outside at all.
emotional_tells.es: Voss mantuvo las manos en los bolsillos del abrigo y la voz serena, pero el intercambio de maletines delataba prisa. El ramo de la hija distanciada aun estaba envuelto en papel de ferrocarril cuando le avisaron. Los guantes secos del guardia de anden decian que no habia salido en absoluto.
emotional_tells.fr: Voss gardait les mains dans les poches de son manteau et la voix posee, mais l'echange de sacoches trahissait la hate. Le bouquet de la fille eloignee etait encore enveloppe de papier de chemin de fer quand on l'a prevenue. Les gants secs du garde de quai disaient qu'il n'etait pas sorti du tout.

cold_case_physical.en: The platform was swept before the morning departure. The cipher sheet was filed in a drawer no one opened, and the fog that blinded the platform erased every footprint between the tracks. Thornfield Crossing returned to its schedule.
cold_case_physical.es: El anden fue barrido antes de la salida matutina. La hoja cifrada fue archivada en un cajon que nadie abrio, y la niebla que cegaba el anden borro cada huella entre las vias. Thornfield Crossing volvio a su horario.
cold_case_physical.fr: Le quai a ete balaye avant le depart du matin. La feuille chiffree a ete classee dans un tiroir que personne n'a ouvert, et le brouillard qui aveuglait le quai a efface chaque empreinte entre les voies. Thornfield Crossing est retourne a ses horaires.

cold_case_financial.en: The sealed envelope was never recovered from the satchel. The doctored ledger was shelved with the station's quarterly accounts, and the telegram confirming the fraud expired unclaimed at the post office. The brokerage continued its business without interruption.
cold_case_financial.es: El sobre sellado nunca fue recuperado del maletin. El libro manipulado fue archivado con las cuentas trimestrales de la estacion, y el telegrama que confirmaba el fraude expiro sin reclamar en la oficina de correos. La correduria continuo sus negocios sin interrupcion.
cold_case_financial.fr: L'enveloppe scellee n'a jamais ete retrouvee dans la sacoche. Le registre falsifie a ete range avec les comptes trimestriels de la gare, et le telegramme confirmant la fraude a expire non reclame au bureau de poste. Le courtage a poursuivi ses affaires sans interruption.

all_strong.en: Renard Voss had thirty-two minutes between trains, and he used every one. The cipher sheet, the doctored ledger, the satchel swap — each piece locked into place like a signal lever thrown to danger. Verne had carried proof of the fraud in a sealed envelope, and Voss killed him for it on a fog-blind platform. The telegram confirmed everything. The case was closed before the morning departure.
all_strong.es: Renard Voss tuvo treinta y dos minutos entre trenes, y uso cada uno. La hoja cifrada, el libro de cuentas manipulado, el intercambio de maletines: cada pieza encajo como una palanca de senales puesta en peligro. Verne llevaba la prueba del fraude en un sobre sellado, y Voss lo mato por ello en un anden cegado por la niebla. El telegrama lo confirmo todo. El caso se cerro antes de la salida matutina.
all_strong.fr: Renard Voss a eu trente-deux minutes entre les trains, et il les a toutes utilisees. La feuille chiffree, le registre falsifie, l'echange de sacoches — chaque piece s'est emboitee comme un levier de signal mis au danger. Verne portait la preuve de la fraude dans une enveloppe scellee, et Voss l'a tue pour cela sur un quai aveugle par le brouillard. Le telegramme a tout confirme. L'affaire etait classee avant le depart du matin.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Voss was the man — everyone at the crossing knew it by morning. But the how and the why dissolved into fog like breath on a cold platform. The cipher sheet was never fully decoded, the ledger contradictions never resolved. He stood trial with his name on every lip and almost nothing in the evidence box. The conviction held, but only just.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: Voss era el hombre; todos en el cruce lo sabian por la manana. Pero el como y el por que se disolvieron en la niebla como el aliento en un anden frio. La hoja cifrada nunca fue completamente descifrada, las contradicciones del libro nunca se resolvieron. Fue a juicio con su nombre en todos los labios y casi nada en la caja de pruebas. La condena se sostuvo, pero apenas.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Voss etait l'homme — tout le monde au croisement le savait des le matin. Mais le comment et le pourquoi se sont dissous dans le brouillard comme un souffle sur un quai froid. La feuille chiffree n'a jamais ete entierement decodee, les contradictions du registre jamais resolues. Il a comparu avec son nom sur toutes les levres et presque rien dans la boite a preuves. La condamnation a tenu, mais de justesse.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong name was spoken, and the real killer boarded the first morning train without a backward glance. Renard Voss watched the platform recede from a first-class window while an innocent man answered questions in the station office. The cipher sheet remained unread, the fraud unchallenged, and Aldous Verne's death became a footnote in a railway logbook.
wrong_accusation.es: Se pronuncio el nombre equivocado, y el verdadero asesino abordo el primer tren de la manana sin mirar atras. Renard Voss observo como el anden se alejaba desde una ventana de primera clase mientras un hombre inocente respondia preguntas en la oficina de la estacion. La hoja cifrada quedo sin leer, el fraude sin cuestionar, y la muerte de Aldous Verne se convirtio en una nota al pie en un libro de registro ferroviario.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais nom a ete prononce, et le veritable tueur a pris le premier train du matin sans un regard en arriere. Renard Voss a regarde le quai s'eloigner depuis une fenetre de premiere classe tandis qu'un innocent repondait aux questions dans le bureau de la gare. La feuille chiffree est restee non lue, la fraude incontestee, et la mort d'Aldous Verne est devenue une note de bas de page dans un registre ferroviaire.

cold_case.en: The fog never lifted on the Verne case. The platform was swept, the schedule resumed, and the thirty-two-minute window closed as if nothing had passed through it. The cipher sheet was filed, the ledger shelved, and Thornfield Crossing returned to its routine of arrivals and departures. No one asked about the man on platform two again.
cold_case.es: La niebla nunca se levanto sobre el caso Verne. El anden fue barrido, el horario se reanudo, y la ventana de treinta y dos minutos se cerro como si nada hubiera pasado por ella. La hoja cifrada fue archivada, el libro guardado en un estante, y Thornfield Crossing volvio a su rutina de llegadas y salidas. Nadie volvio a preguntar por el hombre del anden dos.
cold_case.fr: Le brouillard ne s'est jamais leve sur l'affaire Verne. Le quai a ete balaye, l'horaire a repris, et la fenetre de trente-deux minutes s'est refermee comme si rien ne l'avait traversee. La feuille chiffree a ete classee, le registre range, et Thornfield Crossing est retourne a sa routine d'arrivees et de departs. Personne n'a plus demande apres l'homme du quai deux.

lucky_guess.en: Voss was named almost on instinct — a damp coat, a monogrammed satchel, a signature that came too late. It was barely enough to hold him, let alone convict. The inspector had guessed right but could not explain how. The fog had given him the answer and swallowed the proof.
lucky_guess.es: Voss fue nombrado casi por instinto: un abrigo humedo, un maletin con monograma, una firma que llego demasiado tarde. Apenas era suficiente para retenerlo, mucho menos para condenarlo. El inspector habia adivinado bien pero no podia explicar como. La niebla le habia dado la respuesta y se habia tragado las pruebas.
lucky_guess.fr: Voss a ete designe presque par instinct — un manteau humide, une sacoche monogrammee, une signature arrivee trop tard. C'etait a peine suffisant pour le retenir, encore moins pour le condamner. L'inspecteur avait devine juste mais ne pouvait expliquer comment. Le brouillard lui avait donne la reponse et avale les preuves.

expressions.suspect:renard_voss: Renard Voss signed the station ledger in a tight hand. His coat hem is damp with platform mist.
expressions.suspect:estranged_daughter: A young woman waited at platform two with a small bouquet. The stems are wrapped in railway paper.
expressions.suspect:stationmaster: The stationmaster's name is on duty for the 11pm watch. His brass watch chain is tucked away.
expressions.suspect:night_porter: The night porter carries a brass key ring with three keys missing. His boots are clean of coal dust.
expressions.suspect:platform_guard: The platform guard's lantern hook is empty. His gloves are dry despite the fog.
expressions.suspect:railway_clerk: The railway clerk has fresh ink on two fingers. His cuffs are neatly folded back.
expressions.suspect:travelling_broker: A broker in a grey coat waited in the lounge. His ticket is first class and unused.
expressions.location:thornfield_crossing: Thornfield Crossing is a two-platform junction with a single office door. The clock above the gate shows 11:07.
expressions.location:platform_two: Platform two is lit by three lamps. The far bench is wet.
expressions.location:platform_one: Platform one faces the signal box. A luggage cart blocks the east end.
expressions.location:station_office: The station office has one desk and a locked cabinet. The window latch is unfastened.
expressions.location:signal_box: The signal box lever for the siding is down. A mug of cold tea sits by the panel.
expressions.location:waiting_room: The waiting room stove is cold. Two chairs are pulled close together.
expressions.location:goods_shed: The goods shed floor is dusted with coal. A crate lid is ajar.
expressions.location:carriage_siding: The carriage siding holds one empty carriage. The steps are damp.
expressions.object:telegram: A folded telegram lies on the office desk. The seal is broken and the paper is creased.
expressions.object:cipher_sheet: A cipher sheet is pinned beneath the blotter. Several columns are marked in pencil.
expressions.object:satchel: A brown satchel rests by the bench. The clasp bears the initials RV in brass.
expressions.object:initialed_cufflink: A cufflink with the letters RV is on the office floor. The hinge is bent.
expressions.object:station_key: A heavy station key sits in the drawer. Its tag reads OFFICE.
expressions.object:ledger_book: The ledger book is open to the accounts page. A line of figures is crossed through.
expressions.object:sealed_envelope: A sealed envelope is tucked inside the ledger. The wax is stamped with a crest.
expressions.object:cash_tin: A cash tin is half full of coins. The lid shows a fresh scrape.
expressions.object:platform_lantern: A platform lantern is unlit on the bench. The wick is trimmed short.
expressions.object:torn_ticket: A torn ticket half is pinned to the wall board. The date reads 12 November.
expressions.object:telegraph_form: A telegraph form lies in the waste bin. The message lines are blank.
expressions.object:ink_blotter: The ink blotter is damp on one corner. The blot has a sharp edge.
expressions.object:coal_dust: Coal dust is scattered on the platform steps. The pattern forms a clear shoe print.
expressions.emotion:fixed_stare: She did not look at the body. She looked at the track beyond.
expressions.emotion:avoided_contact: He answered without meeting the inspector's eyes. His gaze stayed on the timetable.
expressions.emotion:measured_breath: Her breathing slowed as questions were asked. The reply came after two beats.
expressions.emotion:steady_hands: His hands did not shake while handing over the keys. The ring did not jingle.
expressions.emotion:paused_reply: A pause came before the time was given. The answer was short and exact.
expressions.emotion:closed_posture: Arms were kept close to the body. The coat remained fastened indoors.
expressions.modifier:initialed_RV: The initials RV appear on two separate items. The lettering is the same style.
expressions.modifier:paid_off: Coins were found stacked in a neat column. The stack does not match the till count.
expressions.modifier:unlocked: The office latch turns without resistance. The lock shows no tool marks.
expressions.modifier:misplaced: An item rests where it would not be left in routine use. The placement blocks a clear path.
expressions.modifier:unclaimed: No name is written on the property tag. The string is newly tied.
expressions.modifier:smudged: A line of ink is smudged at the margin. The smear runs left to right.
expressions.modifier:damp: Moisture beads on the paper edge. The rest of the sheet is dry.
expressions.modifier:late_arrival: The register shows a signature after the last arrival time. The ink is fresh.
expressions.modifier:lamps_dimmed: The platform lamps burn lower than usual. The glass is clean.
expressions.modifier:ticket_punched: The ticket is punched twice in the same place. The second punch is deeper.
expressions.action:office_entered: The office door was used; the hinge oil is disturbed. A footprint marks the mat.
expressions.action:telegram_handled: The telegram is unfolded and refolded. A thumbprint sits near the code header.
expressions.action:satchel_swapped: Two satchels were present; one is missing. The strap buckle is left behind.
expressions.action:ledger_checked: The ledger has a new crease at the fraud column. The page corner is bent.
expressions.action:platform_crossed: Footprints cross from platform one to two. The prints are over fresh dust.
expressions.action:signal_paused: The signal lever was held at danger. The chalk mark is erased.
expressions.action:guard_bribed: A coin pouch was found under the guard's bench. The string is untied.
expressions.action:door_left_open: The office door was left ajar. The latch is not fully seated.
expressions.action:footsteps_faded: Footsteps lead from the bench into fog. The trail ends at the platform edge.
expressions.time:between_trains: The interval between the last and first trains is thirty-two minutes. No passenger traffic occurs in that span.
expressions.time:last_arrival: The last train arrived at 10:58. The platform cleared by 11:03.
expressions.time:first_departure: The first morning departure is listed at 11:30. The signal is set at 11:25.
expressions.time:fog_thickens: Fog thickened after the last arrival. Visibility reduced to ten yards.
expressions.time:signal_reset: The signal was reset at 11:24. The lever shows a fresh grease mark.
expressions.motive:fraud_concealment: The telegram contains proof of systematic fraud. The names are written in full.
expressions.motive:third_party_link: A third party of social standing is named in the cipher. The name is underlined.
expressions.motive:partnership_ruin: The partnership accounts show a final deficit. The balance would end the firm.
expressions.motive:ledger_exposure: A ledger column titled dividends does not match the receipts. The discrepancy is dated.
expressions.motive:debt_pressure: A promissory note is clipped inside the ledger. The due date is past.
expressions.motive:sealed_proof: The sealed proof is addressed to authorities. The seal is intact but warm.
expressions.witness:ticket_clerk: The ticket clerk recorded a late punch. The log notes platform two.
expressions.witness:porter: The porter moved luggage at 11:05. His cart track ends by the bench.
expressions.witness:signalman: The signalman logged a pause at 11:12. The entry is initialed.
expressions.witness:carriage_cleaner: The carriage cleaner wiped the siding steps at 11:15. The rag is still damp.
expressions.witness:telegraph_operator: The telegraph operator handled a blank form at 11:02. The tray is empty now.
expressions.event:aldous_verne_discovered: Aldous Verne was found on platform two. His watch stopped at 11:16.
expressions.event:platform_two_scene: Platform two was cleared after the last arrival. Only one suitcase remained.
expressions.event:window_between_trains: The thirty-two minute window between trains is recorded. The office was unoccupied then.
